about: How the sequence of operation and points list are found, per job (design §9.8, §10.2). Number patterns are matched, whole, against the section number after estimator.catalogue.spec_sections.section_number has formatted it (a six-digit code spaced in pairs, e.g. '23 09 93'; an old five-digit code left as digits, e.g. '15985'), with any '.suffix' dropped first. Title patterns are searched, case-insensitively, against the section or sheet title. A points list bound into a spec book with no section heading (a spreadsheet export between two sections) is found by points_page_heading in the first points_page_top_lines lines of a page no section covers; a line that also carries a section number (points_page_not_heading) is a contents or cross-reference line, not the list's own heading. Extend here, never in code.
no_sequence_flag: No sequence of operation found — step 5 has no backbone for this job; scope comes from the drawings
no_points_flag: No points list found — the sequence is not cross-checked
